Drag and drop actually moves rows now, the buttons carry their colour instead of just their text, and a download says whether it is going out on an account.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Drag and drop moved nothing on screen, and the cause was the fix before it.** A `FlatList` redraws a row only when its `data` changes by reference or when `extraData` does, and the row's own code reads the drag out of a closure the list knows nothing about. That had always been missing, and had always worked by accident: the list was rebuilt on every render, so the reference kept changing and the rows were redrawn for the wrong reason. Freezing the list during a drag, which was right and fixed the list re-sorting under the finger, made that reference stable and switched off the only thing that had been redrawing the rows. Declaring the drag is one line, and the lesson is worth more than the line: making a reference stable also switches off everything that depended on it changing.
- **The instance cards had the same defect, unreported.** Their status badges and figures read three pieces of state the list could not see, while the list's own data was set once and never again, so every card froze at whatever it said on the first paint while the five-second poll updated numbers nobody redrew. A check now runs in CI and refuses any list whose rows read state it has not been told about; it was verified to fail against the old code before being trusted.
- **A mixed colour did not survive choosing another swatch, and eight swatches could not all be the same.** Two separate causes. Every setter rebuilt the stored settings from the copy its closure was built with, so mixing one swatch and then the next meant the second write erased the first. And which swatch is chosen was worked out from the colour, which collapses the moment two of them are equal. Both are stored facts now.
- **The picker opened on the wrong colour.** It always started from the accent, so pressing a swatch that held something else showed a foreign colour, and the first drag wrote that colour into the slot.
- **The buttons on the connect-with-a-phrase screen were stuck together.** The spacing lived in that screen's own button style, and moving the three onto the shared button took it away with it.

## ✨ Added

- **A download says whether it goes out on an account.** A hoster link with no account behind it looked exactly like one with an account behind it, right up until it was slow, queued behind a countdown, or asking for a captcha. It now says "Free" or "Premium" beside the backend name, in the same quiet metadata ink, and nothing at all for an ordinary file, which is neither.
- **The report button copies instead of sharing**, with a glyph, and says so for a moment afterwards because a clipboard write is otherwise invisible.

## 🔤 Changed

- **Buttons carry the colour, not the text.** A coloured word on a grey ground reads as a link; the point of the colour engine is that the pressable thing is coloured.
- **The About card's first line**, in all 42 languages, now sits next to the repository's own claim and intro.

## 📋 Where things are

- Reordering: **Downloads**, hold a row until the list wiggles, then drag. Both tabs.
- Colours: **Settings › Colours**. Tap a chosen swatch a second time to mix it.
- The mode: beside the size on each row in **Downloads**.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/compare/mobile/v1.15.0...mobile/v1.16.0
